# **How Swipe transformed billing for Laxmi Computers**


**Mukesh Kumar, co-owner of Laxmi Computers in Gowlidoddy** , shares how Swipe has helped simplify billing, improve record-keeping, and make everyday business operations more organised.


The journey of Laxmi Computers did not begin with a business plan. It started with Mukesh working at a mobile shop in Begum Bazar, Abids, where he gained practical experience in customer handling, stock management, and basic billing.


Over time, that experience gave him the confidence to take the next step.


## **How Laxmi Computers started**


The retail experience gained by Mukesh and his brother led them to take a step towards setting up something which was theirs.


So, they set up Laxmi Computers.


While opening their computer shop was certainly a moment to be celebrated, managing its everyday affairs was full of challenges.


One among them was the billing process.


The company required an easy way to create bills, conduct customer transactions, keep track of records and eliminate human errors.


## **How Laxmi Computers discovered Swipe**


Mukesh heard about Swipe through a friend who described how it worked and how it would ease the burden of billing.


The team decided to give it a shot.


What struck them immediately was how intuitive and easy it was to work with.


Rather than having to go through complicated billing procedures, Mukesh and his brother just put in the necessary data to generate the bills.


There were no long learning processes involved.


Swipe was just the simple answer they were looking for.


## **What changed after using Swipe**


Swipe was incorporated into the daily flow of work at Laxmi Computers, making billing easier and more systematic.


Some key changes included:


- The ability to generate bills much faster since there was no need to draw up and calculate each transaction manually.
- Easier management of prior transactions due to better record keeping.
- Not as many manual mistakes involved in billing and calculations anymore.
- The possibility of producing professional-looking bills and receipts in no time.
- The ability to use a straightforward system without obtaining additional training.


Thanks to the fact that billing became a lot easier, the team could spend less time on the paperwork and focus more on serving customers.


## **How Swipe helped improve customer experience**


While billing may appear to be a minor aspect of operating a retail store, it influences the customer experience.


Customers anticipate their bills to be precise, easy to understand, and provided without any unwanted delays.


By using Swipe, Laxmi Computers was able to produce bills that are well arranged and issue receipts faster.


The improved record management also allowed the team to have more clarity while processing customer transactions.


Over time, this has improved the billing experience for customers.


## **A simpler way to manage everyday billing**


Before the use of Swipe, a retailer would have to do calculations on their own to generate invoices. Thus, the task was quite time-consuming.


Through the use of Swipe, this task is made simple.


With the new innovative software, putting in the needed information into the device and getting the ready invoice wherever you are became a simple task.


As a result, a retailer can save valuable time thanks to Swipe.


## **Final thoughts**


The experience of Laxmi Computers with Swipe illustrates the immense contribution a proper billing app can make in easing a key component of running a small business.


A solution to the serious problem of proper billing soon turned into part and parcel of the workings of the shop. With Swipe on board, Mukesh and his brother conducted their work more effectively due to efficient billing, well-organised operations, and accurate calculations.


For shop owners and small business owners struggling with paper bills and manual calculations, shifting to a reliable app will allow them to run their businesses more easily and comfortably.
